taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-01 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1056.4 | 23.97 | 23.97
2 | 1090.4 | 1.46 | 25.43
3 | 2606.8 | 3.17 | 28.60
4 | 3560.6 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-01
Curve type: AA-type
Aquifer depth: None identified (or N/A)
Recommendation: Drilling is not recommended at this location due to uniformly high resistivities exceeding 1,000 Ω·m, indicating dry, massive, and impermeable bedrock with very poor groundwater potential. If drilling proceeds, explore alternative survey stations nearby with lower resistivity profiles.
